scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,PANEL,MOBILE -c cyan,green,yellow "npm --prefix apps/web_next run dev" "npm --prefix apps/panel_flutter_web run dev" "npm --prefix apps/mobile_flutter run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:panel && npm run build:mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:panel && npm run lint:mobile
scripts.clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force apps/web_next/.next,apps/web_next/node_modules/.cache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force apps/mobile_flutter/build,apps/mobile_flutter/.dart_tool -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force apps/panel_flutter_web/build,apps/panel_flutter_web/.dart_tool -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
scripts.build:owner: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Push-Location apps/panel_flutter_web; flutter build web --release --target lib/main_web_owner.dart --base-href /owner/; Pop-Location; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force deploy/owner -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force deploy/owner | Out-Null; Copy-Item apps/panel_flutter_web/build/web/* deploy/owner -Recurse -Force"
scripts.build:admin: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Push-Location apps/panel_flutter_web; flutter build web --release --target lib/main_web_admin.dart --base-href /admin/; Pop-Location; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force deploy/admin -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force deploy/admin | Out-Null; Copy-Item apps/panel_flutter_web/build/web/* deploy/admin -Recurse -Force"
scripts.build:next: powershell -NoProfile -Command "npm --prefix apps/web_next run build; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force deploy/next -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force deploy/next | Out-Null; Copy-Item apps/web_next/.next deploy/next/.next -Recurse -Force; if (Test-Path apps/web_next/public) { Copy-Item apps/web_next/public deploy/next/public -Recurse -Force }; Copy-Item apps/web_next/package.json deploy/next/package.json -Force; Copy-Item apps/web_next/next.config.mjs deploy/next/next.config.mjs -Force"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:owner && npm run build:admin && npm run build:next
